entries.text: '''Dangerous Bedfellow''': Protagonists must work alongside a someone who is normally a villain.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Dangerous Bedfellow''': Protagonists must work alongside a someone who is normally a villain.

entries.text: '''Uncomfortable Bedfellow''': Protagonists must work alongside a someone who is normally a rival.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Uncomfortable Bedfellow''': Protagonists must work alongside a someone who is normally a rival.

entries.text: '''He's Just A Pain To Work With''': Protagonists must work alongside a someone who is unpleasant or problematic.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''He's Just A Pain To Work With''': Protagonists must work alongside a someone who is unpleasant or problematic.

entries.text: '''Inversion''': The victim is the villain, the villain is the victim.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Inversion''': The victim is the villain, the villain is the victim.

entries.text: '''Opportunity for Debt''': Protagonists meet others who can help them... for a favor.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Opportunity for Debt''': Protagonists meet others who can help them... for a favor.

entries.text: '''Curse You For Your Sudden But Inevitable Betrayal!''': The villain is somebody the protagonists know personally, even to the point of respect or love.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Curse You For Your Sudden But Inevitable Betrayal!''': The villain is somebody the protagonists know personally, even to the point of respect or love.

entries.text: '''No Violence''': Protagonists must succeed without violence.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''No Violence''': Protagonists must succeed without violence.

entries.text: '''Be Discreet''': Protagonists must succeed while using special discretion.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Be Discreet''': Protagonists must succeed while using special discretion.

entries.text: '''Up Shit Creek''': Protagonists must succeed without powers, equipment, or other resources they usually have.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Up Shit Creek''': Protagonists must succeed without powers, equipment, or other resources they usually have.

entries.text: '''It's You! Again!''': The antagonist is a recurring foil.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''It's You! Again!''': The antagonist is a recurring foil.

entries.text: '''Where Others Have Failed Before''': Another group comparable to the protagonists has already failed, and their remains provide clues.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Where Others Have Failed Before''': Another group comparable to the protagonists has already failed, and their remains provide clues.

entries.text: '''Oh S***, Bystanders''': There are innocents nearby that the protagonists must keep safe while dealing with the adventure.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Oh S***, Bystanders''': There are innocents nearby that the protagonists must keep safe while dealing with the adventure.

entries.text: '''Oh Crap!''': The adventure begins suddenly and without warning or buildup.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Oh Crap!''': The adventure begins suddenly and without warning or buildup.

entries.text: '''I'm Not Who You Think I Am''': The protagonists must pretend to be someone else.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''I'm Not Who You Think I Am''': The protagonists must pretend to be someone else.

entries.text: '''Doing A Snape''': The protagonists must pretend to be themselves but with very different allegiances, values or tastes.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Doing A Snape''': The protagonists must pretend to be themselves but with very different allegiances, values or tastes.

entries.text: '''Bang!''': The protagonists can't do everything and must choose between two evils.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Bang!''': The protagonists can't do everything and must choose between two evils.

entries.text: '''It's A Simple Word''': The protagonists must make a personal sacrifice or others will suffer.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''It's A Simple Word''': The protagonists must make a personal sacrifice or others will suffer.

entries.text: '''Fire-Fighting''': The protagonists aren't asked to solve the problem, just to render aid against a of larger issue.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Fire-Fighting''': The protagonists aren't asked to solve the problem, just to render aid against a of larger issue.

entries.text: '''Messianic Complex''': One of the protagonists is presumed to be a savior and/or patsy, which is the adventure's kicker.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Messianic Complex''': One of the protagonists is presumed to be a savior and/or patsy, which is the adventure's kicker.

entries.text: '''Enter The Rivals''': There is another group of protagonist-like characters ''competing'' on the same adventure.
entries.raw_text: 1,'''Enter The Rivals''': There is another group of protagonist-like characters ''competing'' on the same adventure.
